notes: Gloamgarden sporekin: a mushroom cap over a petal skirt. The mesh is modelled turned 30 degrees towards its left (feet and hands both lie on a line 30 degrees off X), so it is fitted facing forward and the bind is turned to face +Z. The overhand smash and the zombie claw both fold the spine far enough to lay the wide cap over the whole body, so it casts (Spell_Simple) instead: the branch arm thrusts forward and the cap stays up.
